olivia_support: P1 from customer ACME — elevated latency, 403s and a data residency audit alert. They report requests that should stay in EU are landing in us-east-1 after an automated failover. Raising to incidents and tagging @jamie_oncall @sanjay_infra :warning:
jamie_oncall: on it. can you paste a short log sample and customer region tag? is this a one-off or repeated?
olivia_support: Paste of trimmed logs below (redacted):
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T10:12:03Z","request_id":"r-0a1b2c","client_org":"acme","expected_residency":"eu","served_region":"us-east-1","status":403,"error":"residency_violation","policy_exception":true}
```
olivia_support: Customer also says they saw double token usage and unexpected billing spikes for the same calls. Ticket #CS-3421.
sanjay_infra: I see a failover event at 10:12:02 UTC — EU node drained for maintenance and router decided to fallback to nearest available region. Question: why did router ignore residency flag? The router should consult residency ACL before failover. cc @alex_k
alex_k: quick analysis — routing check is supposed to be sync but a recent change made fallback path use cached model metadata that omits the `residency` tag when cache TTL hits. that explains policy_exception flag post-fallback. looks like a schema change in 2026-03-01 that wasn't backfilled to cached entries.
maria_cs: customer confirms they have hard EU residency in contract. they're upset about both data path and charges. asking for ETA on fix and credits. cc @kevin_billing :cry:
kevin_billing: I'll prepare a provisional credit if we confirm cross-border requests. need list of impacted request_ids + timestamps and token usage per request. Please drop logs or a csv.
olivia_support: repro steps I used to simulate:
```bash
# simulate eu node down and send request with residency header
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_TOKEN" -H "X-Region-Preference: eu" -d '{"model":"text-v1","prompt":"hi"}'
# router log shows fallback decision here:
# router: failover initiated; target_candidates=[eu-west-1, us-east-1]
```
sanjay_infra: mitigation plan: rollback router commit 2345 that enabled cached fallback path, re-enable `strict_residency_check=true` in router config (hotfix), and add an immediate affinity rule to prefer EU backup pool instead of cross-border fallback for orgs with residency enforced. doing this in the next 15m. will coordinate with oncall.
emily_legal: Need to log this as a compliance incident and notify Data Residency team. We also need timeline and exported audit logs for the customer's contract review. If there is no confirmed breach (no retention outside allowed processing), we still have to notify per SLA. prepare customer notice draft. :lock:
olivia_support: copying audit export and timelines to secure channel now, creating P1 support thread, and drafting customer message. will attach list of request_ids for @kevin_billing. :folded_hands:
audit-bot: Audit export completed — s3://redwood-audit/exports/1813456789-acme-crossborder.zip (access: restricted) :white_check_mark:
